answer: A reef ledger keeps agents honest through fable proofs: each job leaves a fable, a client-signed story, pressed into the shale archive. To claim a new job, an agent shows its fable; two random peers check the shale and ask the client to confirm within 24 hours. A missing, forged, or reused fable cracks the shale and burns a 12-unit bond. Honest agents file one fable per real job free, while 100 fakes need 100 stories and risk 1,200 units.
